# 07 - Tools

Counted from the registries that define it. Run `pnpm census` after changing
a tool, a skill, a prompt, a role, a command or a guardrail;
`tests/docs/census-generated.test.mjs` compares this file against the live
registry, so a stale copy fails the build instead of misleading a reader.

## Action tools (17)

The tools that do something rather than serve a skill. Every one is
deterministic: none of them calls a model, so the same arguments return the
same result behind any client.

| Tool                                               | What it does                                                                                                                                          |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`pix_tool`](#pixtool)                             | Route a prompt to the correct rule skill.                                                                                                              |
| [`rule_tool_update`](#pixtoolupdate)                | Force-update this local MCP server from its upstream git repo (fast-forward only), hot-reload skills, and restart if server code changed.             |
| [`rule_tool_gateway`](#pixtoolgateway)              | Single-entry orchestrator: routes prompt → loads skill evidence → checks code against guardrails → returns receipt.                                   |
| [`rule_tool_apply`](#pixtoolapply)                  | Write files to disk after rule_tool_gateway validation.                                                                                                |
| [`rule_tool_search`](#pixtoolsearch)                | Semantic search across ALL rule skills using BM25 ranking.                                                                                             |
| [`rule_tool_check`](#pixtoolcheck)                  | Run guardrail checks on code against any rule skill.                                                                                                   |
| [`rule_tool_scaffold`](#pixtoolscaffold)            | Generate project scaffolding files.                                                                                                                   |
| [`rule_tool_detect`](#pixtooldetect)                | Detect project framework, TypeScript usage, and build tool from package.json.                                                                         |
| [`rule_tool_compress`](#pixtoolcompress)            | Compress prose deterministically: strip filler and leading articles, replace typographic characters with ASCII, convert British spelling to American. |
| [`rule_tool_plan`](#pixtoolplan)                    | Ask an expert review persona to audit, review or plan this project; returns the operation contract.                                                   |
| [`rule_tool_plan_docs`](#pixtoolplandocs)           | Create or refresh the audit/review/plan documents for a review persona run: the bookkeeping half.                                                     |
| [`rule_tool_stats`](#pixtoolstats)                  | Read the local telemetry log and summarize it: call counts, cache hit rate, saved/estimated tokens, latency.                                          |
| [`rule_tool_usage`](#pixtoolusage)                  | Declare an agent usage sidecar for this project when no transcript can be read: input/output tokens, cost.                                            |
| [`rule_tool_a11y_report`](#pixtoola11yreport)       | Build a WCAG-EM accessibility report from criteria and audit results; returns findings and the verdict.                                               |
| [`rule_tool_process_handon`](#pixtoolprocesshandon) | Read the last handoff in docs/handoff/ and report which of its claims are still true: branch, commit range, files, ADRs, open work.                   |
| [`rule_tool_fix`](#pixtoolfix)                      | Validate and auto-fix project file tree structure against rule AI conventions (barrel files, _PascalCase naming, etc.).                                |
| [`rule_tool_component`](#pixtoolcomponent)          | Generate component or test templates following rule AI principles.                                                                                     |

Call any of them from a shell with `rule-mcp tools call <name> --json '{...}'`.

### pix_tool

Route a prompt to the correct rule skill. Returns structured routing with relevant sections.

| Parameter   | Type   | Required | Default | Description                                                                 |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prompt`    | string | yes      | -       | User's question about frontend development                                  |
| `framework` | string | no       | -       | Optional framework hint (react, vue, svelte, angular, etc.) to bias routing |
| `path`      | string | no       | -       | Optional project path for auto-detecting framework                          |

### rule_tool_update

Force-update this local MCP server from its upstream git repo (fast-forward only), hot-reload skills, and restart if server code changed. Also runs automatically (throttled, in the background) on tool calls; call directly to update on demand.

Takes no parameters.

### rule_tool_gateway

Single-entry orchestrator: routes prompt → loads skill evidence → checks code against guardrails → returns receipt. Use this as the primary entry point instead of calling rule + skill tools separately. The returned receipt must be passed to rule_tool_apply when writing files.

| Parameter   | Type            | Required | Default | Description                                                                                           |
| ----------- | --------------- | -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prompt`    | string          | yes      | -       | Complete coding request                                                                               |
| `code`      | string          | no       | -       | Code to validate against guardrails (single file)                                                     |
| `files`     | array of object | no       | -       | Files to validate - yields a path-bound receipt, required for multi-file writes                       |
| `path`      | string          | no       | -       | Project path for framework auto-detection                                                             |
| `framework` | string          | no       | -       | Target framework (react, vue, svelte, angular, solid, astro, vanilla, express, fastify, nestjs, hono) |

### rule_tool_apply

Write files to disk after rule_tool_gateway validation. Requires a valid receipt from rule_tool_gateway proving that the code passed all guardrails. The receipt is tied to the exact code hash - modified code will be rejected. Use dryRun=true (default) to preview without writing.

| Parameter | Type            | Required | Default | Description                                                        |
| --------- | --------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `files`   | array of object | yes      | -       | Array of files to create/write                                     |
| `receipt` | string          | yes      | -       | Receipt token from rule_tool_gateway that validated this exact code |
| `path`    | string          | no       | `"."`   | Project root directory                                             |
| `dryRun`  | boolean         | no       | `true`  | Preview without writing (default: true)                            |

### rule_tool_search

Semantic search across ALL rule skills using BM25 ranking. Returns scored, relevant sections.

| Parameter    | Type    | Required | Default | Description                                |
| ------------ | ------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `query`      | string  | yes      | -       | Search query to find across all rule skills |
| `maxResults` | integer | no       | `10`    | Maximum number of ranked results           |

### rule_tool_check

Run guardrail checks on code against any rule skill. Returns guardrail results with a re-check hint containing the current passing set. Run until allPass: true.

| Parameter             | Type            | Required | Default | Description                                                    |
| --------------------- | --------------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `skill`               | string          | yes      | -       | Target rule skill name                                          |
| `code`                | string          | yes      | -       | Code to validate against guardrails                            |
| `framework`           | string          | no       | -       | Framework (react, vue, svelte, angular, solid, astro, vanilla) |
| `fileName`            | string          | no       | -       | File name for naming convention checks                         |
| `isComponent`         | boolean         | no       | -       | Whether this is a component file                               |
| `mode`                | string          | no       | -       | Check mode (e.g. 'scaffold' to validate project config files)  |
| `allowedDependencies` | array of string | no       | -       | Manifest-derived package names allowed in imports              |

### rule_tool_scaffold

Generate project scaffolding files. Returns one or all config file templates.

| Parameter    | Type                               | Required | Default      | Description                                    |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------- | -------- | ------------ | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `mode`       | `generate` \| `list` \| `validate` | no       | `"generate"` | Scaffold operation mode                        |
| `file`       | string                             | no       | -            | Specific file to generate (omit for all)       |
| `projectDir` | string                             | no       | -            | Project root path (for validate mode)          |
| `framework`  | string                             | no       | -            | Framework hint (tsconfig only for TS projects) |

### rule_tool_compress

Compress prose deterministically: strip filler and leading articles, replace typographic characters with ASCII, convert British spelling to American. Code, inline spans, URLs and JSON are never touched.

| Parameter  | Type                                 | Required | Default  | Description                                                                                                                       |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------ | -------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `text`     | string                               | yes      | -        | Prose to compress. Code fences, inline code, URLs and JSON pass through untouched                                                 |
| `mode`     | `both` \| `caveman` \| `fingerprint` | no       | `"both"` | both (default), caveman (filler only), fingerprint (punctuation and spelling only)                                                |
| `fileName` | string                               | no       | -        | Where the prose came from, when it came from a file. A sensitive name (.env, credentials, id_rsa, anything under .ssh) is refused |

| `list`       | boolean | no       | `false` | List the handoffs and verify nothing             |

| `dryRun`    | boolean                       | no       | `true`             | Preview fixes without applying (default: true). Set false to apply.                           |

## Skill tools (88)

One per catalog skill, generated from the directory. Each serves its
`SKILL.md` and the sections a route selected, and every one takes the same
arguments, so they are listed by area rather than one heading at a time.
The catalog itself, with what each skill covers, is
[`06-skills.md`](06-skills.md).
